seoTitle: How to Create a Quiz in Jotform: Step-by-Step Guide
metaDescription: Build a self-grading quiz in Jotform using the Quiz App integration — add questions, mark correct answers, and show instant results to respondents.
intro: Building an interactive, self-grading quiz doesn't require separate quiz software when you're already using Jotform. By combining the Form Builder with the native Jotform Quiz App, you can create question fields, assign correct answers, and let respondents see their results instantly. This guide covers the full setup from question layout to automated scoring.

steps.heading: Start your form and layout
steps.body: Choose an optimized canvas layout from the Jotform dashboard and add basic fields like name and contact info.

steps.heading: Add your question fields
steps.body: Use single choice, multiple choice, and true/false blocks to build out your quiz questions.

steps.heading: Open the Jotform Quiz App
steps.body: Navigate to the external Jotform Quiz integration portal and grant it permission to access your form.

steps.heading: Mark correct answers and assign points
steps.body: Go through each question, select the correct answer, and set up automated grading rules and point values.

steps.heading: Configure results display
steps.body: Set up your confirmation screen so respondents see their score immediately after submitting.

steps.heading: Share and track submissions
steps.body: Copy your public quiz link and monitor responses through Jotform's submission analytics.

faq.question: Can respondents see their score right after finishing?
faq.answer: Yes, once you configure the confirmation screen through the Quiz App, results can display instantly to the person taking the quiz.

faq.question: Do I need a separate app to grade quizzes?
faq.answer: No, the Jotform Quiz App integration handles scoring and grading directly within your existing form, no third-party tool required.

faq.question: What question types can I use?
faq.answer: The tutorial covers single choice, multiple choice, and true/false question blocks, which cover most common quiz formats.

faq.question: Can I email results to respondents automatically?
faq.answer: Yes, automatic email results can be set up as part of the quiz configuration alongside the on-screen thank you page.
